QuestInfo.name: Find the Master of Combos
QuestInfo.0: You reach Level 15 and #b#p9010010##k approaches you to start a conversation...
QuestInfo.2: You were able to check your highest combo score. You're think you're starting to get used to combos now.

0.0: Hey, Aran! How's it feel to return to Maple World? Are you still sore? Do your muscles ache? Haha, we know you're still struggling to adapt to the new world, so we prepared a nice #bevent#k for you. Wanna hear what it's all about?

yes.0: The event is called Find the Master of Combos! You know combo attacks are your specialty, right? This event is all about combos! When your Combo score reaches a certain level, you'll be acknowledged as a master of combos and get a medal!
yes.1:
#i1142134# Over 50 #t1142134#
#i1142135# Over 200 #t1142135#
#i1142136# Over 500 #t1142136#
...Doesn't look that easy, does it? But I think you can do it.
yes.2: If you don't know what your highest combo record is, don't worry. I'll tell you. Anytime you check your score, if you meet the requirements, you'll get a medal! Isn't that cool?
yes.3: Oh, and one more thing. The MapleStory website is currently running a web event related to this as well. Anyone that has received a medal will automatically be entered into a raffle for some some amazing prizes!
yes.4: Oh, I almost forgot to tell you the most important thing. The event runs from #bDecember 10th to January 19th#k. That means you only have a limited time to show off your skills. Good luck!

no.0: Eh? You're not interested in the event? If you change your mind, let me know!
